title: Workflow Discipline
description: Use for setup, codegen, migrations, deploys, containers, or test infrastructure. Covers no hidden manual pre-steps, rerunnable workflows, and cleanup/resource discipline.

requirements.statement: The completed solution must not require a human to run an undocumented/manual pre-step for normal use; required setup must be part of the sanctioned workflow or clearly documented as an operator-approved procedure.
Any sanctioned setup/seed/migration/retry workflow touched by this task must be safely rerunnable on preserved state without manual cleanup.
Any temporary services, containers, worktrees, test data, or scratch infrastructure created by the task must be cleaned up or explicitly documented as intentionally still active.
